title: Each Hook call gets its own state

slides.say: Call a custom Hook twice. Do the two calls share one state? No.
This Hook declares one state variable called value.
Form calls it twice. That works exactly like declaring two separate state variables. Each call is completely independent.

slides.text: Need the same state in two components? Lift it up, don’t share a Hook.
slides.say: Custom Hooks share stateful logic, not the state itself. To share state, lift it up and pass it down.
